title: Effect of Metaxalone 640 mg (M640) on Driving, Cognition, and EEG Dynamics Compared to Tizanidine 8 mg in Adults
official: Assessment of the Effect of Metaxalone Tablets, 640 mg (M640) on Driving Ability, Cognition, and Electroencephalographic (EEG) Dynamics Compared to Tizanidine 8 mg in Adult Participants: A Prospective, Single-blind, Within-subject Study
summary: Participant takes a single pill after eating, takes a driving test on a simulator, takes thought and concentration computerized tests
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults, aged ≥ 18 and ≤ 65 years of age at the time of consent.
* Weigh at least 120 pounds at Screening/Baseline and Baseline.
* Medically healthy
* Able to take oral medication.
* Possesses a valid driver's license.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current use of any medications known to affect sleep-wake cycle.
* Has a sleep disorder.
* Positive urine test for amphetamines, barbiturates, cocaine, opiates, benzodiazepines, or cannabinoids
* Known history of alcohol or substance use disorder
* Participants with a history of cognitive disorders, depression, schizophrenia, panic disorder, or dementia.
* Participants with a history of seizure disorder or epilepsy.
* Participants with scalp conditions, dermatologic disease, or hair/scalp characteristics
